reason: Every broad State-dossier discovery candidate has a reviewed disposition or resolves directly to a canonical identity. The review is additionally bound to the exact Git tree of dossiers/states so any dossier-content change forces explicit corpus re-review/re-pinning before the zero-backlog ratchet can pass again.
semantics: review priority orders curation work only and has no governance meaning
ratchet 0 means zero unreviewed raw candidates, not zero uncertainty or zero deferred items
the threshold does not redefine Actor, Project, evidence, attribution or R/S/U/N
future new raw candidates are in scope immediately because every review priority is at or above zero
the reviewed_state_dossier_tree pin binds the review overlay to the exact canonical State-dossier corpus; any tree drift invalidates the review until explicitly re-reviewed
